title: Fullstack Entwickler TypeScript – Node.js / Angular, KI-Integration (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen und öffentlichen Auftraggebern, eingebettet in deren Teams, mit voller Verantwortung für deinen Bereich.

- Fullstack-Entwicklung mit TypeScript: Node.js im Backend, Angular im Frontend

- Sprachmodelle in Fachanwendungen einbauen: RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten, die im Regelbetrieb laufen

- Architektur mitgestalten, nicht nur umsetzen

- Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor

- Code Reviews und technisches Mentoring im Team

- Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, UX und DevOps

Die meisten kommen ein bis zwei Tage die Woche in eins der Büros. Zwang ist das aber keiner. Kundentermine finden meist in Frankfurt am Main statt, alle paar Wochen für einzelne Tage.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt und deiner Erfahrung:

- Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel (Reisendeninformation, Kundendialog, Vertrieb)

- Öffentlicher Sektor / Behörden (z. B. Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund) – regulierte Umgebungen, Barrierefreiheit, Security by Design

- Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen

Unsere Kunden stellen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten besetzt. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

Das erwarten wir: 

- TypeScript auf beiden Seiten, mindestens drei Jahre in Projekten

- Node.js im Backend (NestJS oder Express), REST- und API-Design, PostgreSQL

- Angular (wenn du aus React oder Vue kommst und dir Angular zutraust: bewirb dich trotzdem, sag es in den Fragen)

- Mindestens eine Anwendung, in der du ein Sprachmodell eingebaut hast: RAG, Tool-Calling, MCP-Server oder Agenten

- Tests gehören bei uns zur Definition of Done, nicht in die Nacharbeit

- CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), Git, Docker, agiles Arbeiten

Von Vorteil (kein Muss): 

- Kubernetes/Helm, AWS oder Azure

- Kafka oder RabbitMQ, WebSockets

- Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Frontend-Tests (Jest, Playwright, Cypress)

- Barrierefreiheit (BITV 2.0 / WCAG AA), DevSecOps / Security by Design

- Erfahrung bei Bahn, Behörden oder Sozialversicherung

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

- Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest

- MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)

- Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

- Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

- Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer (TypeScript)
location: Canada,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Portugal,  Spain,  UK
description:
About Maze 

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development. 

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey —and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values .

Location: Remote , preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal. Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the Product Engineering team, you'll design and deliver high impact features, working closely with product, design, and other engineers to solve complex problems, build scalable solutions, and ensure our systems are maintainable and performant.

You’ll take ownership of projects from concept to production, contribute to architectural decisions, write high quality code, and help raise the technical bar by sharing knowledge and best practices with your teammates.

You'll work on:

- 
Building elegant features for user researchers to analyze and extract compelling insights from qualitative data, using both classical techniques and large language models 

- 
Expanding audience management to help researchers connect with and reward participants from across the world

- 
Integrating video and scheduling tools to provide a streamlined experience for managing and booking user interviews

As a product engineer at Maze, you will:

- 
Partner closely with product managers, designers and other engineers to design, build, and ship new features

- 
Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable us to measure the impact of every feature that we ship 

- 
Evaluate and improve the performance, maintainability, and security of applications in production

- 
Work in a collaborative and open team, which places high value on feedback, continuous learning and trust.

You should apply if:

- 
You're proficient with modern full-stack JavaScript (Node.js and React) and relational databases (PostgreSQL)

- 
You're enthusiastic about well-tested code and strive to improve your work environment

- 
You have excellent written and spoken English skills

- 
You thrive in a remote environment

Bonus points:

- 
You have Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and/or TypeScript experience

- 
You have experience with AWS and/or Kubernetes

- 
You're interested in UX, UI design, and the research field

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package. 

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

- 
Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

- 
Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

- 
Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

- 
Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

- 
For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

- 
Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

- 
Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

- 
Flexible time off

- 
Meaningful equity

- 
Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

- 
New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

- 
Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

- 
$500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage 

- 
If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

- 
$1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

- 
Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

- 
Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

- 
Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year 

- 
SWAG, we have some really cool swag

- 
Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here . 

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application , as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

title: Freelancer Senior Mobile Engineer (React Native, Expo, TypeScript) m/w/d
description:
Willkommen bei easybill. 

22.000+ Unternehmen verlassen sich auf easybill. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Rechnungen, Prozesse und Integrationen im Alltag einfach laufen. Mit easybill-mobile bringen wir zentrale Funktionen unserer Plattform auf iOS und Android – und suchen dich, um die App technisch und produktseitig mitzugestalten.

Du bekommst klare Prioritäten, kurze Wege und Raum, um Dinge sauber zu lösen. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung: für technische Entscheidungen, durchdachte Nutzerführung und eine App, auf die sich unsere Kundinnen und Kunden unterwegs verlassen können.

Das ideale Profil? Du bist Freelancer und in TypeScript, React Native und Expo richtig tief drin, verstehst die Besonderheiten mobiler Anwendungen und möchtest ein Produkt in einer frühen Entwicklungsphase entscheidend prägen. Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit, um Funktionen auch auf Seiten unserer REST-API mitzugestalten.

Aufgaben

Du entwickelst easybill-mobile auf Basis von React Native, Expo und TypeScript für iOS und Android weiter. Eine technische Grundlage mit Anmeldung, Dashboard und Dokumentenübersichten ist bereits vorhanden. Darauf baust du auf und gestaltest die nächsten Schritte gemeinsam mit dem Team.

- Du übersetzt Anforderungen rund um Rechnungen und Dokumente in verständliche mobile Abläufe und hochwertige native Oberflächen.

- Du entwickelst die App-Architektur weiter und schaffst wartbare Strukturen für Navigation, wiederverwendbare Komponenten, Formulare und Datenzugriffe.

- Du bindest unsere REST-API an und sorgst für verlässliches Datenmanagement: von typisierten Schnittstellen und Validierung bis zu Caching, Ladezuständen und Fehlerbehandlung.

- Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen App und Backend. Bei Bedarf erweiterst du unsere REST-API auf Basis von PHP und Symfony, damit neue mobile Funktionen durchgängig umgesetzt werden können.

- Du arbeitest an sicherer Authentifizierung, Session-Verwaltung und dem sorgfältigen Umgang mit sensiblen Kunden- und Geschäftsdaten.

- Du behältst Performance und Plattformbesonderheiten im Blick – auch bei wechselnden Netzverbindungen, App-Wechseln und unterschiedlichen Geräten. Barrierefreiheit und Mehrsprachigkeit gehören für dich zur Produktqualität.

- Du sicherst Änderungen mit automatisierten Tests und prüfst das Verhalten auf Simulatoren und echten Geräten. Du gestaltest Build-, Release- und Monitoring-Prozesse bis zur Veröffentlichung in den App Stores mit.

- Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, bringst eigene Lösungsvorschläge ein und begleitest Funktionen von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Weiterentwicklung.

- Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code intensiv im Entwicklungsalltag und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Korrektheit der Ergebnisse.

Unser Mobile-Stack umfasst React Native, Expo, Expo Router und TypeScript. Dazu kommen TanStack Query und TanStack Form, Zod und NativeWind. Für Tests setzen wir auf Jest und React Native Testing Library. Unsere bestehende Plattform und die REST-API basieren auf PHP und Symfony.

Qualifikation

- Du musst nicht jede Bibliothek bereits kennen. Entscheidend ist, dass du deinen Stack verstehst, gute technische Entscheidungen triffst und dich selbstständig in neue Themen einarbeitest.

- Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit TypeScript, React Native und Expo auf Senior-Level und hast mobile Anwendungen über die reine Implementierung hinaus bis zum Release begleitet.

- Du verstehst React, Komponentenarchitektur, Zustandsverwaltung und asynchrone Datenflüsse und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich strukturieren.

- Du kennst die Besonderheiten von iOS und Android und gehst systematisch an Performance-Probleme, Plattformfehler und Debugging heran.

- Du bist sicher in der Anbindung von REST-APIs und verstehst API-Verträge, Authentifizierung, Validierung und Fehlerbehandlung.

- Idealerweise bringst du zusätzlich Kenntnisse in PHP und Symfony mit. Du kannst bestehende API-Endpunkte verstehen, Fehler zwischen App und Backend analysieren und Schnittstellen eigenständig erweitern.

- Automatisierte Tests, nachvollziehbare technische Entscheidungen und wartbarer Code gehören für dich zum Entwicklungsalltag.

- Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch, kommunizierst klar und behältst den Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden im Blick.

- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte sind Erfahrung mit EAS, nativen Modulen in Swift oder Kotlin sowie App-Store-Veröffentlichungen und mobilen Release-Prozessen. Auch eigene veröffentlichte Apps, Open-Source-Beiträge oder öffentliche Experimente auf GitHub sind willkommen.

Wenn du nicht jedes Kästchen erfüllst, aber ein außergewöhnlich starker Engineer bist: Bewirb dich trotzdem und zeig uns, was du gebaut hast. Zeig uns, was du gebaut hast!

Benefits

- Remote-First Team – keine Bindung an einen Standort

- Eine inspirierende und flexible Arbeitsumgebung, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung basiert

- Die Möglichkeit, an der Gestaltung der Unternehmensstrategie und -kultur mitzuwirken

- Ein engagiertes Team und die Chance, gemeinsam an innovativen Lösungen zu arbeiten

- Regelmäßige Teamevents

Help build fair, engaged and high-performing teams.
We believe everyone deserves a fair opportunity to develop and be rewarded for the value they bring. That’s why we build software that helps organizations set clear expectations, define what a role entails, assess performance fairly, support employee growth, and make compensation transparent and explainable. From clear roles to fair rewards, all within one continuous process. Will you join us in driving this change?

Please note: for this role, it’s important that you already live in the Netherlands and are able to work from our Utrecht office at least three days a week.

The opportunity 
As our new Web & Mobile Full Stack Developer, you’ll help build and improve our SaaS platform across all surfaces: mobile, web and backend. You’ll work on our React Native mobile app as we scale it into a fully independent experience for mobile-first markets. You’ll contribute just as actively to our web platform, from intuitive user interfaces in React to scalable APIs and backend services in Node.js .

Your average week in Utrecht:

- Building and shipping new features in our React Native mobile app (around 50% of your time)

- Building and shipping new features on our web platform, with React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend (around 50% of your time)

- Shaping features together with product and design to improve the user experience

- Working in structured weekly sprints with your team

- Writing clean, scalable and maintainable code in TypeScript, React, React Native, Node.js and MongoDB

- Building and improving performant, secure REST APIs

- Contributing to technical discussions and architecture decisions, including our mobile strategy

- Reviewing pull requests to keep quality high

- Improving developer workflows, CI/CD and automated testing

- Owning features from idea to deployment, across mobile and web

In short: your work directly makes our platform faster, smarter and more scalable, helping our customers grow and pushing Learned to the next level 🌱

The team 
You’ll join a development team of 6 developers in Utrecht, working closely with 11 colleagues in Sri Lanka through a buddy system that keeps lines short. The team is led by Alex, our CTO. We’re an international company of 55 people (7+ nationalities) serving 350+ customers, increasingly at enterprise level. With the EU Pay Transparency Directive coming up, demand for our product is growing fast, and so is our roadmap.

Your growth 

- Learning every day from experienced, senior colleagues across mobile, web and backend

- Hands-on experience building AI features into a product used by hundreds of companies

- A personal development budget of €1,000 per year

- An open feedback culture: we practice what we preach

The musts 

- You already live in the Netherlands and can work from our Utrecht office at least 3 days a week

- Around 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer

- At least 1 year of experience building production apps in React Native

- Solid experience with TypeScript, React and Node.js (or comparable stacks), including REST APIs

- Experience building or integrating AI features in a product (e.g. LLM features, agents or retrieval)

- You enjoy switching between mobile, frontend and backend, and owning features end-to-end

- You communicate clearly and confidently in English

- You’re proactive, take ownership and love learning together through feedback

The nice-to-haves 

- Experience with MongoDB or similar databases

- Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and cloud infrastructure

- Experience publishing apps to the App Store and Google Play

- Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally HR tech

The benefits 

- A salary between €4,000 and €5,500 gross per month (based on 40 hours, depending on experience), with room to grow

- 25 vacation days (based on full-time)

- A pension plan (10%, of which we pay 50%)

- A personal development budget of €1,000 per year (based on full-time)

- A MacBook Pro and everything you need to do your job well

- Travel expense reimbursement via our mobility plan

- A hybrid setup: at least 3 days at the office, flexible beyond that

- The option to work remotely from abroad for up to 6 weeks per year

- Daily healthy lunches, Friday drinks and monthly team activities 🎉

- An ambitious, international environment where we challenge each other and celebrate wins together

Sounds good? 🙌 We’d love to hear from you. Who knows, we might be meeting each other soon.

At Isar Aerospace, we are building the technology and infrastructure needed to make access to space more affordable, sustainable, and scalable.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Lead Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the development of modern internal software platforms and applications that support our rapidly growing organization.

In this role, you will design and build software solutions that connect people, processes, and data across engineering, manufacturing, operations, and business functions. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand challenges, identify opportunities for automation and digitalization, and turn ideas into intuitive, scalable applications.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of greenfield software development, influence architectural decisions, and help shape how we build internal technology at Isar Aerospace.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, moves quickly from concept to working software, and combines strong engineering fundamentals with a pragmatic, product-oriented mindset.

Your role in our Space Mission... 

Software Development & Architecture

- Collaborate with enterprise systems and data engineering teams to ensure applications integrate effectively into the broader technology landscape.

Technical Leadership & AI-Assisted Development

- Use technologies such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or OpenAI Codex to accelerate prototyping, development, testing, and documentation where appropriate.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and development approaches, selecting tools based on practical business value.

- Contribute to the growth of internal software engineering capabilities, including mentoring future team members.

- Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

What you´ll need to thrive... 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on full-stack development.

- Strong proficiency in modern frontend development using TypeScript/JavaScript and frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.

- Experience building responsive web applications and mobile-friendly interfaces.

- Familiarity with cloud platforms, containerization, Docker, and Kubernetes.

- Experience with event-driven architectures, data pipelines, or real-time applications.

- Practical experience using AI coding assistants and autonomous coding agents to improve software development productivity.

- Experience working in fast-growing companies or greenfield product development environments.

- Prior experience providing technical leadership, mentoring developers, or owning application architecture.

Beyond technical proficiency, we´re looking for someone who... 

- Builds, not just designs. You are comfortable making architectural decisions but equally happy writing code, debugging issues, and delivering working software.

- Thinks like a product owner. You care about the end user's experience and the real-world problems your software solves.

- Thrives in ambiguity. You can turn loosely defined problems into actionable requirements and working solutions without extensive direction.

- Moves quickly and pragmatically. You understand when to prototype rapidly and when to invest in robust, scalable engineering.

- Takes ownership. You are comfortable being accountable for the applications you build, from initial concept through production operation.

- Embraces new tools. You actively explore modern development techniques, including AI-assisted software engineering, while maintaining high standards for code quality and security.

If you are a hands-on engineer who enjoys building products, solving complex problems, and turning ideas into working software, we'd love to hear from you.

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role 

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

- Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

- Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

- Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

- Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

- Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

- Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

- Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

- Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

- Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

- Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

- Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

- Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes 

- Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

- Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

- AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

- Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack 

- TypeScript

- React.js / Next.js

- HTML / CSS

- WebSockets / streaming APIs

- Node.js

- REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work 

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process 

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

About the Role 

Supabase Storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

- 
Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake

- 
Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

- 
Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation

- 
Improve the performance, observability, and reliability of our storage server

- 
Work with the frontend team to build a fast, powerful storage explorer

- 
Improve our APIs, client libraries and CLI to provide an exceptional end-to-end DX for our users

- 
Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform

Have 5+ years backend engineering experience of running Node.js in production

Display empathy towards developer experience

Professional Development

- Kubernetes clusters and managed databases

- A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps

All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs.

What you'll own 

You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill.

- Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses.

- Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity.

- Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades.

- Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap.

- Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps.

- Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems.

- Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet.

- Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning.

- Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform.

Our stack 

Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies

Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering

Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery

Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi

CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries

Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor

Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging

Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall

AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations

Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust

Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka

Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking

Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access

Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud

Must-haves 

- We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines.

Kubernetes, in depth 

- Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions.

- Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure.

- Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work.

- Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster.

- Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables.

- Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore.

- Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux.

- Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics.

CI/CD, in depth 

- Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates.

- CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity.

- Build pipelines: multi-service and monorepo builds with caching and parallel stages, and versioned artifacts. Container images built with Docker, BuildKit or Kaniko, including multi-architecture images, image scanning, SBOMs and signing.

- Deployment pipelines: promotion from dev to staging to production with approvals and quality gates, plus blue-green, canary and fast rollback. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, and database migrations as part of a release.

- Infrastructure pipelines: Terraform or Pulumi plan and apply from CI, with policy checks and drift detection.

- Pipeline security: short-lived credentials through OIDC federation or a secrets vault instead of long-lived keys, least-privilege deploy roles, and protected branches.

- Release engineering for our chain: building and publishing node binaries and images, and coordinating rolling upgrades across validator and RPC fleets.

- Delivery health: you track build time, build cost, flaky tests and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), and you cut wasted builds with ignore rules and caching.

Networking fundamentals 

- TCP/IP, subnetting and CIDR, routing, NAT, and the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing.

- DNS, TLS and certificates, firewalls and security groups.

- Private connectivity: VPC design, peering, private endpoints, and keeping internal traffic off public IPs.

- Troubleshooting with dig, curl, mtr and tcpdump, and understanding what internet egress costs.

Also required 

- Production experience on at least two of Google Cloud, AWS and Alibaba Cloud, and willingness to learn the third quickly.

- Terraform or Pulumi in production, plus scripting in Bash and in Python or Go.

- A track record of cutting a cloud bill with data, through rightsizing, cleanup or commitments.

- A security-first habit with production credentials, and clear written communication.

Nice to have 

- Running blockchain nodes in production, such as CometBFT validators and sentries, EVM archive or RPC nodes, and snapshot pipelines.

- Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and Zero Trust at scale.

- Alibaba Cloud on the international site, including its billing and support model.

- Confidential computing (Intel TDX) and GPU workloads.

- CKA or CKS certification, a FinOps certification, or experience moving a team between CI systems, such as Jenkins to GitHub Actions.

- Go or Rust, enough to read and patch the services you operate.

What we offer

In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses:

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

- What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

- Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

- What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do

- Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

- Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

- Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

- Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

- Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

- Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

- Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because 

- You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer , with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

- You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects.

- You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

- You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

- You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

- You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

- You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

- You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus 

- Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

- Experience running multi-tenant systems.

- Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get 

- Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

- Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

- Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack: 

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

- Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

- DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required: 

- Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

- Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

- Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

- Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

- Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

- Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

- Languages : English. German is a big plus.

- Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

- Availability : 100%, as soon as possible.

- Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred: 

- Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

- Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

- Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset: 

- Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

- Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

- Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

- About you: A short description of yourself.

- Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

- Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

- Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

- Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. 

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or UK Remote | Senior Engineer (L50) £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits | Technology - Engineering 

About our Engineering Teams: 

We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.

These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

Your day-to-day 

This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! 

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work 

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️

Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life: 

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency ✨

If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 

You should apply if: 

- you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product

- you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day

- you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions

- you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity

- you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software

- you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).

- you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing

We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our Engineering Progression Framework - we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you! 

What you’ll be working on: 

We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: 

- Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here )

- Cassandra for most persistent data storage

- Kafka for our asynchronous message queue

- Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 

- Envoy Proxy for RPC

- AWS for most of our production infrastructure and GCP for most of our data infrastructure

- React for our public web apps and internal tools

- We also have physical datacenters with actual cables to connect to various third parties

The Interview Process: 

Our interview process involves three main stages: 

- Initial Call 

- Take home task or pair coding exercise 

- Final interview: including a system design and a behavioural interview 

Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here .

What’s in it for you: 

£105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK 

✅We can sponsor visas.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so there's no closing date for this job. 

#LI-Remote

#LI-NB

Equal opportunities for everyone 

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report. 

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: Lead Automation Engineer
description:
We’re Capital on Tap 
Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that.

Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 

1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We’ve done a pretty good job so far, but we’re just getting started! 

The role starts out fully remote. Once our Lisbon office is open, it will move to a hybrid set-up of two days a week on site.

Salary: €65,000 - €75,000

Quality Engineering at Capital on Tap 

Quality Engineering is embedded across our mission teams, partnering with Engineering, Product, and UX to champion quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. We build quality in from the start - not bolt it on at the end.

The Lead Automation Engineer is a critical, hands-on role embedded within a Mission team. Reporting functionally to your mission team’s Lead, you will be the quality champion for your specific feature set. You will leverage standardised automation tooling to maximise test coverage, accelerate delivery velocity, and maintain the highest quality standards for our products.

What You'll Be Doing ️ 

Mission Team Quality Ownership & Strategy 

- Define and own the comprehensive testing strategy for your domain (e.g., payments, banking, onboarding), ensuring end-to-end quality and compliance in partnership with the QA Team Lead.

- Act as the primary contributor for automation; design, develop, and maintain robust automated tests (API, UI, Mobile).

- Champion a "Shift-Left" mindset, working with Product Owners and Developers from the refinement stage to ensure quality is engineered in from the start.

- Directly manage the mission team’s automation targets and use data-driven insights (MTTD/MTTR, defect escape rates) to predict high-risk areas.

Technical Leadership & Tooling Adoption 

- Serve as the mission team's expert on central automation frameworks, driving consistent adoption of CI/CD processes and quality gates.

- Identify team-specific gaps and collaborate with the central Tooling Team to develop custom helpers or data generators that enhance the core framework.

- Ensure automated test suites are fully integrated into CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, reliable deployment and a "fail fast" mechanism.

- Coordinate complex technical testing, including microservices, security (OWASP ZAP), and performance testing.

Collaboration, Coaching & AI Innovation 

- Coach and upskill developers and junior QA engineers on automation best practices and test design patterns.

- Champion the use of AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot) for complex tasks like architecture exploration, incident investigation, and test generation.

- Leverage component testing, service virtualization, and contract testing to reduce dependencies and enable independent team testing.

- Define test data strategies and environment requirements to support both automated and exploratory testing.

Our Values & Culture 

- Just Pilot: We never settle for “good enough”. We pilot new ideas fast, ask questions to figure it out, and scale quickly.

- Why Not Today? Fast is as slow as we go - speed and simplicity gives us a competitive advantage.

- Be a Buddy: We tap in from day one to help the team, we do the right thing even if it’s hard.

- Owners and Dates: We don’t chase people. If you own a task and agree to a date, the expectation is that it gets done.

- Feedback: We want our employees to flourish, so we regularly provide direct and constructive feedback.

We’re Looking For 

- Experience: 5+ years in QA Automation/SDET roles with proven success leading quality within an Agile team.

- Programming: Strong proficiency in modern languages essential for automation, specifically C# or JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Fintech Expertise: Experience testing complex financial systems (card issuing, transaction processing, or credit risk).

- Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with tools for UI (Playwright, Cypress) and API (REST Assured, Other API testing frameworks).

- Cloud & CI/CD: Familiarity with Azure, Git, and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

- Leadership: Ability to influence without authority, encouraging developers and POs to prioritise automation and quality.

Even if you don’t have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply. 

Interview Process 

- First stage: 30-minute intro, CV review, and values with Talent Partner

- Second stage: 45-minute “Tech Chat” with Team Manager

- Final stage: 60-minute Code Pairing + 30-minute Stakeholder Interview with Engineering & Product

Diversity & Inclusion 
We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work.

Great Work Deserves Great Perks 

Check out our benefits:

Private Healthcare through AdvanceCare
Anniversary Rewards (€280, €570, €860, 4-week fully paid sabbatical)
Paid Car Parking
️ 36 days holiday (inclusive of public holidays with public holidays carried over if they fall on a weekend)
Annual Learning and Wellbeing Budget
6 free therapy sessions per year
Free drinks and snacks in our offices

Other Info
Check out our ‘Top Tips’ for interviewing. 
✔️Keep updated on new job opportunities by following us on Linkedin .
Email careers@capitalontap.com if you have any questions.

Excited to work here? Apply!
If you’d like to progress your career within our fast growing, profitable fintech then click apply and we will aim to get back to you within 3 working days (during busy periods this could take up to 5 working days.)

title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Contractor)
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**This is a contract role expected to last until April 15th, 2027 

Location : This role is Remote in the U.S., with the option to work onsite from our San Francisco, CA headquarters.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. 

About Doximity 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role 

As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will:

- Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates.

- Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours.

What We're Looking For 

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

Must have: 

- Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients.

- Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships.

- Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA.

- Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have: 

- Working knowledge of statistics and visualization.

- Experience working with data visualization tools.

- Advanced Excel skills.

- Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows.

- Experience working in the healthcare industry.

- Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

title: Senior Android Developer (Remote)
description:

Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Android Engineer or Tech Lead who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, not just the tickets in the backlog.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team (Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product) and own the end-to-end development of features that genuinely matter: company accounts and cash flows, banking transactions, card issuance and management, and AI-enabled accounting. You'll help shape architecture decisions, raise the bar on engineering quality, and mentor the engineers around you.

If you're energized by working at the intersection of great mobile engineering and real product impact — this is the role.

What You’ll Do 

- Design and build new features for our Android application, used daily by business owners across Europe.

- Architect and implement reliable, intuitive solutions for:

- Multi-account cash flow management

- Banking transactions and payments

- Physical and virtual card issuance, activation, and control

- AI-powered accounting automation

- Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose .

- Take ownership of code quality, performance, and stability — automated testing and thorough code reviews are non-negotiable.

- Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.

- Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.

- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

Who You Are 

You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

Your experience includes: 

- Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.

- Deep understanding of OOP , SOLID , and Clean Architecture .

- Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — MVI , MVVM , and MVP — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.

- Hands-on experience with our core stack:

- Reactive programming & async: RxJava , Kotlin Coroutines / Flow 

- Dependency injection: Dagger 2 , Hilt , or Koin 

- Networking: Retrofit 

- Navigation: Cicerone , Jetpack Navigation Component 

- Modern UI: Jetpack Compose 

- Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).

- Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.

- Confidence with Git / GitLab , including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD .

- A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.

- Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have 

- Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.

- Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

- Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.

- Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler , Perfetto , Baseline Profiles , or similar.

- Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.

- An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

- Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.

- Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.

- Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

- Ability to evaluate and verify AI-generated output — using automated tests, linters, and critical review to catch hallucinations and errors.

- Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow

- Talent Partner Interview

- Offer

Make a genuine impact on the product 

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. 

Work in the EU 

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. 

Become a stock options holder 

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. 

Receive unwavering support and care 

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. 

Work & Swim program 

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We are not a dev shop and not a consultancy, we're not about scope or hours, we're only about outcomes. We embed through the lifecycle of challenges and the same senior people stay on the problem. AI agents have made engineering throughput cheap, so senior judgment is now the scarce asset: what to build, what to gate, what to trust to production. We're looking for an experienced engineer to join our small crew and play a ~70/30 build-to-lead role:
- Raise the team’s bar without bureaucracy
- Ship production code
- Be the human PR review
- Own the quality delivery system as a product
- Ship spec-first
