title: Head of Technology
description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link 

About garden3d 

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development 

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design 

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community 

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media 

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone 
Mill 
IngredientAI 

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates 

ï¸ Systems that hold up 

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development 

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering 

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer 

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best 

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery 

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business 

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense 

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story 

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture 

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects 

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

- Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
- Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
- Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
- Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
- Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
- Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed
Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have: 

- 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
- Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
- A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
- A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
- All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
- Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
- Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
- A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
- Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)
Nice-to-have: 

- A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
- Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
- Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
- Open source projects they've started or maintained
- Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
- Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
- A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
- Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality
Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech (f/m/d)
description:
About Cosuno 

Construction is a €14 trillion industry that still runs on email, spreadsheets and scanned PDFs. Cosuno is replacing that with AI. General contractors tender their projects on our platform to more than 250,000 subcontractors, and our agentic AI matches the right firms, flags anomalies in bids and benchmarks every price against 6.5 million data points from over €136 billion in processed bid volume. Every tender makes the AI smarter. The results are measurable: general contractors cut costs by around 6 %, subcontractors win 22 % more volume, and every new general contractor customer this year has chosen our AI product. Founded in Berlin in 2019 and backed by Cherry Ventures and Spark Capital with over €40 million raised, we are now scaling our Engineering, AI and Product teams with that capital. That is where you come in.

Your mission 

As our Senior Talent Acquisition Manager – Tech, you make sure every seat in Engineering and Product goes to someone exceptional. You report to Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and work closely with Carmen Pölking (Head of Product). Engineers trust you to tell them honestly what a role at Cosuno looks like, and our tech leads trust you to bring them people who raise the bar.

What you will achieve in your first year 

- You hire 25 people across Software Engineering, Product Management and Product Design, owning every process from intake to signed contract.

- You build warm pipelines of senior engineers before roles open, so we hire through sourcing and referrals instead of agencies.

- Together with our tech leads, you design structured, scorecard-based interview loops, from technical screening to final interview.

- You put Cosuno on the map in the Berlin and European tech community, through referrals, meetups and content with our engineers.

- You advise on levelling, compensation and market trends, so our offers win.

- You make hiring measurable with a monthly dashboard on time-to-hire, conversion and source of hire.

What the job really looks like 

- The best engineers rarely apply. Most of your hires come from your own outreach, so a large part of your week is sourcing and candidate conversations.

- You compete with big tech and AI companies for the same people, and you need a compelling story to win them.

- You talk shop with engineers. You do not need to code, but you understand what a TypeScript full-stack role or an ML engineering role really involves.

- There is no large TA team and no finished playbook. You build the processes while you hire.

- You push back when a profile, a process or a decision is not right. We want you to.

What you bring 

- At least 4 years of recruiting experience, of which at least 2 years in-house at a high-growth tech company, hiring software engineers.

- A track record you can prove in numbers: hires made, time-to-hire and offer acceptance rate. You steer your pipeline by data, not gut feeling.

- Technical fluency: you understand modern tech stacks and roles (full-stack, backend, AI/ML, platform) well enough to assess candidates and challenge hiring managers.

- Proven technical sourcing skills across LinkedIn, GitHub and tech communities, including Boolean and X-ray searches.

- Structured assessment: you have built interview loops with engineering teams and keep them fair, fast and consistent.

- Strong closing skills: you win engineers against competing offers, including from big tech and AI companies.

- Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have 

- German language skills.

- Experience hiring AI/ML engineers.

- Experience with cross-border hiring in Europe, including Employer of Record set-ups.

- Hands-on experience with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, Clay or Lusha.

- Curiosity about construction or other traditional industries.

What we offer 

- Salary: €70,000–90,000 gross base salary per year, depending on experience, plus a variable component of 25 % of your base salary at 100 % target achievement, tied to hires who successfully complete their probation period.

- AI at the core: you work with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter and you have a budget to test new tools.

- Learning budget for your professional development.

- Time off: 25 vacation days per year, rising by one day for each year with Cosuno up to a maximum of 28 days. On top of that, 24 and 31 December are always off.

- Flexibility: fully remote within Germany or from our office in Berlin-Kreuzberg, with flexible hours.

- Top equipment: a new MacBook Air.

- A great team: open and international, with regular off-sites and team events.

- Stability: permanent contract in a well-funded company.

Our hiring process (max. 4 weeks) 

- Intro call with Vivien (People Lead), 30 minutes, video.

- Live Case Study with one of our Engineers, 60 minutes.

- Career deep-dive with Maximilian Seifert (CTO) and Carmen Pölking (Head of Product), followed by a conversation about our culture and values with Vivien Littmann (People Lead), 60 minutes in total.

- References: with your consent only, we speak with 1 or 2 hiring managers you have recruited for in previous roles.

- Offer.

From your first call to our decision, the process takes no longer than 4 weeks.

Your contact: Vivien Littmann, People Lead

We welcome applications from everyone who brings the skills for this role, regardless of background or circumstances. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About Payflows 

At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it. 

But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool. 

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤 

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter. 

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform , where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. 

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized. 

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters. 

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future. 

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗 

🚀 What you’ll actually do 

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day. 

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved. 

In a typical week, you might: 

- Design and implement new services for a product feature. 

- Refactor an early service to make it more robust. 

- Investigate a performance or production issue. 

- Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature. 

- Review code and help teammates improve. 

- Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations. 

- Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them. 

Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists . Both matter. 

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production. 

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time. 

💻 Our current tech reality 

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏 

Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools. 

- Core language: Python 

- Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic 

- Data: PostgreSQL 

- Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense 

- Performance: some Rust for critical paths 

- Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about 

Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in. 

Over the next year, we’ll focus on: 

- Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents 

- Simplifying services 

- Improving tests and observability 

- Making performance more predictable 

- Cleaning up early code 

We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step. 

✨ Who’s going to thrive with us 

You’ll probably feel comfortable here if: 

- You like building products people actually use. 

- You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship. 

- You take initiative and lead by example. 

- You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out. 

- You’re pragmatic about trade-offs. 

- You communicate with kindness and clarity. 

This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of: 

- Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans. 

- Designing reliable, safe automation in production. 

- Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly. 

You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖 

🧩 What you’ll get from this role 

- Real ownership over parts of the system. 

- Direct impact on customers and product decisions. 

- A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝 

- A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements. 

- Exposure to real scaling and production challenges. 

- The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside. 

We offer: 

- Competitive salary and equity. 

- Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone). 

- A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact. 

- Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product. 

- A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication. 

This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Who are we?

Recare is one of the leading digital startups in the German healthcare industry and has set itself the task of rethinking healthcare with a platform for digital care coordination. We search, find and coordinate capacities so that the healthcare actors have more time for their patients.

Within a very short time, Recare was able to gather around 75 percent of German acute hospitals as well as more than 26,000 care and rehabilitation facilities on its digital platform. Renowned hospitals and hospital groups such as Vivantes, Sana Kliniken AG, München Klinik, Hannover Medical School and Essen University Hospital are among Recare’s customers and use the Recare platform.

We believe artificial intelligence will transform healthcare more profoundly than any technology since the internet, and we’re building that future today, not tomorrow. While the German healthcare sector has historically focused on the risks of new technologies, we see an unprecedented opportunity to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges with AI. With most German acute hospitals now using the Recare platform, we take our leadership responsibility seriously: we’re helping clinics achieve what once seemed impossible, from automation of administrative workflows with the Recare AI platform to unlocking billions in value through predictive analytics. The potential is real, the technology is ready, and the time is now.

Role & team summary

As a senior member of the AI team, you will work on building cutting-edge agentic systems that work reliably in production environments where privacy and correctness are top priorities. This is a hands-on role: you will own key AI initiatives end to end and work across products, since the hardest problems here span more than one team.

Our team is small but growing fast; we are highly independent and hold ourselves accountable for the quality of our work. Technical excellence is expected, but our ideal colleague shares our passion for building impactful solutions that make it all the way into production. As one of our most experienced engineers, you will mentor others, help shape our AI technical strategy, and work with product and business stakeholders to turn open questions into clear recommendations. We want to improve society, not just brag about building fancy tech!

What you’ll work on

- Agentic applications: Build robust chat and generative AI applications on agentic frameworks, designing and optimizing core agent behavior: routing, tool calls, context management, grounding, and instruction-following. Every output is a draft until a clinician releases it, and the system is built for that.

- Evaluation: Measure the real value of agentic systems through observability data, custom evaluation metrics, and user feedback, and use those results to improve prompts, models, and system design.

- GenAI observability: Set up and improve logging, tracing, metrics, dashboards, and prompt management for our AI systems.

- Deployment and integration: Develop and maintain the infrastructure that ships AI agents into REST APIs and web UIs, including containerization, orchestration, and API development.

- Safeguarding health data: Embed security best practices and uphold compliance to protect sensitive health information.

- Technical direction: Track new AI developments, turn the promising ones into production-ready implementations, and help set the direction of our AI work.

What we’re looking for

- 8+ years of relevant industry experience, with a strong AI/ML background, at senior level or above.

- Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered products (RAG, agents) in live production. Research projects and prototypes alone aren’t enough here; we want to hear about systems real users depended on. If your background is in productionizing traditional ML systems rather than LLMs, we still want to hear from you.

- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, such as golden datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, or offline and online metrics, and with systematically improving prompts and models.

- Solid deep learning experience applied to real-world problems, with a focus on system-level integration rather than model training alone.

- Strong coding skills across the stack. Ours includes Python, Go, GitHub Actions, and AWS, and you’re comfortable reading and fixing code outside the main codebase.

- Proficiency in Python and at least one web framework (FastAPI, Django, Flask, …).

- Experience in environments where security and privacy are top priorities, such as PII redaction, LLM guardrails, and GDPR compliance.

- Experience leading, mentoring, and supporting other engineers.

- Experience shaping technical direction and making well-reasoned recommendations to product and business stakeholders, especially where strategy is still evolving.

- Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical people alike, the ability to explain complex topics simply, and a track record of collaborating well across teams.

- A solution-driven mindset: you analyze problems thoroughly and then drive them to resolution.

- Nice to have: experience in regulated industries such as healthcare or fintech, ideally including AI products certified as medical devices, and German language skills, since our customers are German-speaking.

Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box. If you want to dedicate yourself to meaningful work alongside a team that feels the same, we’d love to hear from you.

What we offer

- Growth: We invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership, or exploring new AI approaches. If you grow, we grow.

- Purposeful work: Your work has a real impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

- Company culture: Flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics, and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition.

- Flexibility: Need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours, and workations by arrangement.

- Edenred card to use according to your needs.

- Your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

Location 

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within the European time zone. We’re hiring in Germany (including Berlin), Austria, Poland, France, Italy, Spain, and Portugal.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role: 

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

You’ll join our customer project teams as one of the first technical faces of Celonis. You’ll work hands-on across the full integration toolkit: deploying our out-of-the-box extractors, building custom API connectors in a low-code environment, writing code for push-based ingestion, connecting Celonis to customer lakehouses and LLMs, and configuring writebacks, SSO, and user provisioning. Part implementation consultant, part integration engineer, part trusted technical advisor, this role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants broad exposure to enterprise architecture and modern data and AI integration patterns.

The work you’ll do: 

Data integration and ingestion: 

- Implement standard extractors. Install, configure, and troubleshoot Celonis out-of-the-box extractors in customer landscapes, including SAP (ECC and S/4HANA), JDBC-based databases, and cloud applications such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and others.

- Build custom API connectors. Design and build custom connectors with Celonis Extractor Builder for source systems that expose data through REST or SOAP APIs, handling authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys, certificates), pagination, rate limits, and incremental (delta) loads.

- Enable push-based ingestion. Help customers design and develop scripts and pipelines (typically in Python) that push data to Celonis via the Data Ingestion API, and advise on file formats, scheduling, and error handling.

- Connect to the lakehouse. Set up zero-copy data sharing between Celonis and customer lakehouses such as Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Sharing configuration, access controls, and data freshness.

- Unblock infrastructure. Work through on-premise agent deployments, networking, proxies, firewall and IP allowlisting, certificates, and service-account permissions with customer IT and infrastructure teams.

- Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, monitor pipeline health, and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, AI, and platform connectivity: 

- Close the loop with writebacks. Configure Action Flows and other integration patterns that write back to customer systems (for example, updating records in SAP, Salesforce, or ticketing tools) so Celonis insights turn into action.

- Connect Celonis to AI. Help customers connect Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP (Model Context Protocol), covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance: 

- Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

- Be the security translator. Support customer security, privacy, and compliance reviews, explain the Celonis architecture and data flows, and advise on topics like data minimization, pseudonymization, and least-privilege access.

Customer and team impact: 

- Scope with confidence. Run technical discovery, document integration architectures and requirements, and estimate effort so projects start on solid footing.

- Partner across teams. Serve as a technical point of contact for customer IT, data, and security stakeholders, and work closely with Value Engineers, Data Engineers, Project Managers, Partners, Support, and Product & Engineering.

- Be the voice of the field. Escalate product gaps and bugs with clear, reproducible detail, and share field feedback that shapes our integration roadmap.

- Build reusable assets. Contribute reusable connector templates, scripts, runbooks, and best-practice documentation that scale across customers and partners.

The qualifications you need: 

- 5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as solutions engineering, integration or implementation consulting, data engineering, or technical consulting.

- Hands-on experience with REST APIs and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, tokens); comfort using tools like Postman to explore and test APIs.

- Solid programming skills in Python (or a similar language) and strong SQL skills.

- Working knowledge of data pipelines and ETL/ELT concepts, including incremental loads, scheduling, and handling large data volumes.

- Familiarity with identity and access management concepts such as SSO (SAML/OIDC) and SCIM provisioning.

- A basic understanding of networking and security fundamentals (TLS and certificates, proxies, firewalls, VPNs).

- The ability to explain technical topics clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and to manage your own workstreams across multiple customer projects.

- Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward solving problems hands-on.

- A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have 

- Experience with SAP data structures, tables, or extraction (for example, RFC, ODP, or S/4HANA).

- Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and/or lakehouse platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or Snowflake.

- Exposure to iPaaS or low-code integration tools (for example, MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or Power Automate).

- Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.

- Experience with Docker or Linux server administration.

- Relevant certifications (for example, Celonis, cloud, or SAP certifications).

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy: 

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices 

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

description:
Company Description

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Job Description

Overview 

Design and build the software that provisions, integrates, and operates high-performance storage for GPU-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will develop the control-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale-out storage systems to Kubernetes-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

We are looking for a software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. The right candidate has built production software against real storage systems (whether enterprise NAS, scale-out, or object), understands what makes storage fast and reliable at scale, and prefers declarative automation over manual operations. You should be self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, and effective communicating technical decisions across teams.

Responsibilities 

1. Storage Software & Integration 

- Design and build control-plane services, drivers (e.g., CSI), and tooling that provision, configure, and operate storage for Kubernetes-based AI/compute workloads.

- Integrate high-performance storage platforms — Dell PowerScale, VAST, and comparable systems — into automated, declarative provisioning workflows.

- Build data-path, telemetry, and observability tooling to diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues.

2. Software & Automation

- Deliver infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps-driven pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux) for storage configuration and lifecycle.

- Support bare-metal and hybrid provisioning where storage intersects host and cluster bring-up.

3. Platform & Hybrid Delivery 

- Deliver storage integration for k0s-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies.

- Architect storage software for fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of software development, including production systems, with Go as a primary language.

- 5+ years building or integrating storage systems (distributed, scale-out, NAS, or object) at scale.

- Hands-on experience with high-performance storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale, VAST, or comparable technologies.

- Solid understanding of storage fundamentals: file/block/object models, throughput and latency behavior, caching, consistency, and failure modes.

- Experience with Kubernetes storage (CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes) and infrastructure-as-code.

- Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred 

- Proficiency in Python and/or Rust in addition to Go.

- Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, k0s, MKE) and Cluster API.

- Experience developing storage for GPU/AI workloads (high-throughput data pipelines, GPUDirect Storage).

- Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

title: AI Native Product Engineer
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role: 

Join us as a Product Engineer to build a new product within Brevo called Brevo OS.

Brevo OS is a startup inside Brevo: a team of six, a product we started from an empty repository earlier this year, and the feel of a small company within the big one. The product works, the first customer deployments are beginning, and a great deal is still undecided — so the people who join us now will shape what it becomes.
It's an AI-native operating system for small businesses: a system of agents that helps a solopreneur, a hair salon or a building contractor run their whole business — clients, contracts and signature, invoicing, their website, their inbox. Modules get added the way an ERP grows, except the whole thing is built around agents from the ground up.

Your Impact at Brevo: 

- Turn a very high level business need into something real : understand the function, define the users, the smallest useful version, the entities and their lifecycles, the permissions and constraints that matter, and what to build versus integrate

- Decide which of our platform primitives to extend rather than reinvent, then build it, ship it, watch it in production, and improve it

- Work across product management, frontend, backend, data modelling, infrastructure, and AI. Everyone arrived with a specialism and nobody is confined to theirs; product thinking and business analysis is part of everyone’s job

- Build almost entirely through coding agents: Claude Code is the workflow, not a pilot running alongside it, for implementation, codebase exploration, documentation, debugging, and operations

- Decompose problems into work an agent can actually execute, give it context without over-constraining it, and tell the difference between correct and merely plausible

- Verify with tests and instrumentation, not vibes, and keep a large generated codebase coherent

- Work day to day in TypeScript, Kubernetes, and agentic frameworks

Who you are: 

- Around 2-5 years of professional engineering experience. We care more about your slope than your years.

- Real depth in something, and no attachment to staying there. Bring what you're genuinely strong at — the team compounds those — and expect to spend a good part of your time well outside it.

- Coding agents already central to how you work. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, something equivalent. Not "I've generated the Unit Tests" — real delegation of substantial work, and real review of what comes back. Scepticism about generated output is a feature of this job, not a problem.

- Evidence you've owned a problem, not just implemented a ticket — something you helped define, drove, shipped and then lived with in production. Product questions are your questions too.

- At your best when the brief is one sentence and the plan is still moving . We're learning what this product is, so priorities change often. The mission doesn't.

- English. We're an international team working across France and India, and English is our working language. French is not required.

If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

Why people love working at Brevo: 

- A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighbourhood.

- Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

- Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

- Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

- Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several prevention, health and wellbeing services on the Welii platform.

- A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

Our candidate journey: 

- Introductory TA call (30 min)

- Interview with our VP Engineering (60 min)

- Live Use case (2 hours)

- Final interview with the Global VP & People Business Partner (30 min)

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

You'd join the engineering team to own features end to end, with a strong lean toward the interfaces and workflows clients interact with directly. This is a product engineering role. - Product judgement and attention to detail, especially in workflows used directly by customers

- Comfort deciding what to build now, what to make durable, and what to leave out

- EU or UK citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defence contracts)

Nice to have: 

- Experience with PostGIS, GIS, mapping, or other geospatial systems

- Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or multi-step ML and LLM workflows

- Experience deploying software on-prem, offline, or as an appliance

- Experience with front-end performance and data-dense interfaces

- Prior work in defence, government, or dual-use technology

What's In It For You

- Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity)

- Paris or London based

- End-to-end ownership of product used in real operational environments

The Process

- Talent screening : 30 min, online. Background and motivation.

- Technical screening : 45min, online. Skills assessment.

- Onsite in Paris : half day (3 hours). System Design, Re-engineering and Project Presentation.

Mission of this role 

As an interim Senior QA Specialist at Rentman, you make sure every release reaches customers without regressions. You own the test strategy across our 3 product teams and finish moving regression testing from a manual release-day cycle to an automated, shift-left E2E suite. Without this role, quality depends on manual testing on release day, bugs show up in staging or production, and the move to automated testing stalls. This is an interim position: the duration is still to be confirmed, and the role ends once the assignment is complete.

What you'll do 

- Join refinement with the product teams and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

- Test new features on staging, going beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

- Write and review Playwright tests (TypeScript) in the frontend repo, and review developer-written tests in pull requests

- Monitor the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions, triage failures the same day, and fix flaky tests at the root cause

- Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan for each release, and give a clear go / no-go call

- Migrate the remaining legacy tests and decide what is worth automating and what stays manual

- Organise cross-team QA days and coach developers so they own their tests

What we are looking for 

- 5+ years in QA on web applications

- At least 2 years writing and maintaining UI test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools

- Strong manual and exploratory testing, with bug reports developers can act on without follow-up questions

- You have defined a test strategy (what to automate, what to test manually, coverage), not only executed test cases

- Experience running automated tests in CI (GitHub Actions or similar)

- You get developers to adopt new habits through pairing, good examples and clear specs, not by policing

Nice to haves 

- Experience with complex B2B SaaS

- Playwright specifically, and Gherkin / BDD

- Experience leading a shift-left change or coaching developers to own their tests

- API testing (REST, Postman or similar)

- Basic security testing (e.g. OWASP ZAP)

- Mobile app testing (iOS / Android)

What you’ll get 

- Competitive salary based on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance

- A results-based bonus based on company performance (up to a full 13th month's salary)

- 25 vacation days to recharge

- Earn an extra day of PTO for each year at Rentman, from your second anniversary up to five years.

- A 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years to go on an adventure

- Flexible WFH policy & work from anywhere for 4 weeks a year

- Pension plan through BrightPensioen

- An annual training budget to grow your skills

- Your choice of a shiny new Windows, Linux, or Mac

- An ambitious, inclusive, and diverse international team

- A flexible, energizing workplace with free lunches, office perks (PS5, ping pong, D&D), legendary karaoke nights, and regular team activities

- An amazing office in the heart of Utrecht, in the historic Drift 17

Our process

Je nach Projekt: Großkonzerne wie Deutsche Bahn / DB Systel, öffentlicher Sektor (Bundesagentur für Arbeit, ITZBund, Bundesdruckerei) sowie Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden – jeweils die Cloud- und Plattform-Themen.

Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Senior-Level. Unsere Kunden brauchen Leute, die ab Tag eins liefern und eigenständig arbeiten.

- AWS in der Tiefe – Architektur und Betrieb (idealerweise AWS-Zertifizierung: Solutions Architect oder DevOps Engineer)

- Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (oder CloudFormation), Docker, Kubernetes oder OpenShift

- CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions; Git, agiles Arbeiten

- Linux sowie Netzwerk- und Security-Grundlagen

- Scripting: Python, Bash oder Go

Von Vorteil: IAM (One Identity, Keycloak), Cloud Security, Monitoring (Grafana, Prometheus), Apache Kafka, Azure oder GCP, Go für Plattform-Tooling, Event-driven Architekturen, GitOps (ArgoCD), AWS-Kostenoptimierung.

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Umgebungen reinfindest. Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder höher.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Nicht weil wir hip sein wollen, sondern weil unsere Kunden das erwarten und wir auch so arbeiten. Wenn du AI-Tools für einen Hype hältst und lieber alles selbst tippst: falsche Firma. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

- Homeoffice, Büro oder Mix, du entscheidest

- MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)

- Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

- Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

- Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Introduction 

We’re expanding and have a fantastic opportunity for a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our mechanical and biomedical engineering department. We want to deepen and broaden the skills we already have in the group, and to add to its great culture. This role would suit someone in the early stages of their career, looking for a new challenge within an innovative company.

This team works predominantly across healthcare projects, and you will use your engineering skills at all stages of the development life-cycle, taking responsibility for design challenges and technical problems.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What you’ll be doing 

The majority of your time will be spent delivering exceptional mechanical engineering for our multi-national medical technology clients, understanding their requirements and communicating clearly and effectively. You will be hands-on in solving complex mechanical challenges, often alongside other disciplines, within supportive project teams.

You will work on projects across a range of healthcare sectors, including medical devices, drug delivery, surgical systems and diagnostics instruments. The technical challenges we tackle are ground-breaking, innovative and make a real difference to the landscape of medical technology.

You will guide aspects of the mechanical development and define technical solutions, using your experience to design systems and parts for manufacture by applying real-world knowledge. Your work is likely to include:

- First-principles engineering analysis

- Concept generation and the development of engineering designs

- Rapid prototyping

- Hands-on testing and experimentation, including the design and execution of test programmes

- Detailed design for manufacture and assembly, and liaising with suppliers

- Presenting results, both internally and to clients

- Preparing technical reports and producing high-quality documentation

Our culture encourages team members to take on the level of responsibility that suits them. You will have the opportunity to significantly develop your skills and career, learn from others and make a substantial impact on our projects.

We are keen to support the development of our employees, and as such offer an extensive in-house training program. As you advance within the organisation there will be plenty of opportunities for you to develop your technical skills and specialism, take on more leadership responsibilities and/or focus more on supporting the development of sales opportunities.

What you can bring 

You’ll bring strong mechanical engineering ability and enthusiasm to the role. You will deliver high-quality work on client projects, to specification and to timelines. You will be responsible for delivering the tasks you’re assigned, and for defining tasks for yourself and often for others.

We’re looking for applicants who can demonstrate:

- An excellent undergraduate degree in Mechanical Engineering (or a related subject such as Biomedical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or Mechatronics) or equivalent experience

- Design engineering industry experience, for example (but not limited to) high proficiency in CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), design analysis, structural analysis, rapid prototyping, technical drawings, design for manufacture and design for assembly

- A proven track record of working in a diverse team and of successful delivery

- A creative and analytical approach to problem-solving and concept generation

- Strong written and verbal communication

In addition, experience in any of the following would be advantageous (but is not essential):

- Experience in a consulting environment

- Experience in medical device development, or other regulated product development

- Familiarity with analysis tools such as Python/MATLAB, CFD and FEA

- An interest in applying engineering to the biomedical field

What we do 

Cambridge Consultants is one of the world’s leading product development and technology consultancies, with a reputation for cutting-edge design, development and value creation for a global client base. We develop breakthrough technology for some of the most exciting companies on the planet. Our people, facilities and work make us unique. Our medical technology division develops some of the most novel products, with tangible and often life-changing benefits for users and patients.

What we offer 

- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)

- Company bonus (profit share)

- Flexible working patterns and hybrid working

- Medical insurance and group income protection

- Employee assistance programme and mental health support group

- Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

- Sabbatical leave

- Travel insurance (business and leisure)

- Generous company pension plan

- Personalised career development and training plans

- Free breakfast and two-course lunch in the office every day

- Free onsite parking and we are close to public transport links

- A variety of events organised by our social committee, ranging from summer and Christmas parties to board game nights and socials at our own rooftop bar!

Why Cambridge Consultants? 

At Cambridge Consultants, you'll contribute to radical, new-to-the-world innovation that transforms business, society and the planet. Joining our multidisciplinary teams means helping to turn bold ideas into reality, harnessing the power of deep tech to create products, services and experiences that have never existed before. Whether you're advancing technologies, shaping strategy, supporting operations or driving commercial growth, it's an opportunity to make a real impact and help create the future.

By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.
