title: Head of Technical Program Management, Applied AI
description:
About LILT 

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. 

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

About the Role 

As Head of Technical Program Management for Applied AI, you will drive and own all project execution, customer outcomes, and delivery excellence across LILT’s Applied AI practice

for the world's leading AI labs. Serving as builder and coach, you will lead the people, operations, and systems behind every Applied AI engagement — multilingual and multimodal training data, evaluations, and benchmark programs — and make sure each one ships on time, on budget, and to the highest quality bar. You are responsible for constructing LILT’s technical program management capabilities from the ground up while actively developing, mentoring, and elevating a high-performing team. Operating at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and industrial-scale execution, you hold total accountability for every customer engagement —ensuring every deliverable across your entire team meets the highest standards of precision, speed, and technical rigour.

This is an operator's role: you will balance high-stakes operational ownership with a builder and coach mindset. You will manage and run a high-volume, high-velocity delivery organization: Technical Program Managers, project managers, and the expert and vendor workforces behind them. You bring equal passion to building the operational systems and cadence, capacity models, quality systems, and execution frameworks that power our AI lab deliverables, and coaching your team to operate as high-agency "CEOs" of their respective customer portfolios, , all while staying close enough to the work to step into a critical program or a customer escalation when it matters. You are technically fluent enough to partner with researchers and engineers, but your edge is turning complex, ambiguous customer requirements into reliable, repeatable delivery. While you empower your team to drive day-to-day execution, the buck stops with you for overall portfolio health, customer retention, program SLAs, and delivery outcomes.

Responsibilities 

- End-to-end Practice Ownership: Serve as the single point of accountability for customer outcomes across all Applied AI programs — technical delivery, project work and timelines, quality SLAs, margin, and customer satisfaction. You own top-line program success metrics, quality SLAs, delivery timelines, and customer satisfaction across all Applied AI projects.

- Lead and scale the delivery team: Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class team of TPMs and project managers. Set clear goals, coach for ownership, unblock across complex technical and operational challenges, and build a team that runs complex programs independently.

- Run delivery operations and capacity planning at volume: Own capacity planning, staffing, and resource allocation across programs. Turn shifting customer demand into reliable production plans and delivery forecasts that protect speed and margin.

- Build the delivery operating system: Standardize intake, scoping, kickoff, quality control, reporting, and close-out. Turn individual program learnings into repeatable playbooks, systems, processes, and dashboards.

- Strategic Customer Partnership & Escalations: Act as executive partner and delivery sponsor for key frontier AI lab relationships. Proactively co-develop benchmark transcreations with customer research leads. Lead escalations, run business reviews, and help shape scope, pricing, and timelines with Sales.

- Own quality: Partner with Research to standardize quality control across delivery, including embedded calibration, gold sets, inter-annotator agreement, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, model eval pipelines and root-cause analysis into every customer program, ensuring that quality issues are proactively controlled and mitigated.

- Manage the expert and vendor workforce: Work with Expert Supply and Operations to qualify, manage, and engage multilingual contributors and vendors, with clear performance and cost metrics.

- Cross-functional Workflow Design and Execution: Design, build, and optimize scalable program frameworks for text, image, video, and audio modalities. Turn complex technical requirements into seamless operational realities, bridging Sales, Engineering, Research, Product, Production, and Engineering to scope and build project workflows that are designed optimally, launched quickly, and executed smoothly

Qualifications 

- Accountable Mindset & Ownership: Proven track record as the final owner of large-scale, mission-critical technical portfolios, with direct accountability for project delivery, customer outcomes, and SLA adherence. Demonstrated experience architecting mitigations for AI-specific operational risks (e.g., dataset contamination, domain drift, quality decay, and SLA vulnerabilities).

- Experience: 10+ years in delivery, operations, or program leadership, including 5+ years managing managers or multi-team delivery organizations.Proven ownership of a large, customer-facing delivery portfolio with accountability for SLAs, quality, and margin.

- Builder & Coach Mindset: Proven track record of building technical program functions, processes, and systems from scratch, coupled with a deep dedication to coaching, mentoring, and growing talent.

- People Management & Leadership: 5+ years of direct people management experience building and scaling TPM, Product, or Engineering teams within high-growth AI or enterprise tech environments.

- Frontier AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on understanding of the modern AI landscape—including LLMs, multimodal models, training/inference pipelines, and complex dataset diversity (multilingual and multi-domain). Hands-on experience delivering AI training data, human data, LLM evaluation, annotation, or localization programs at scale, with distributed contributor or vendor workforces.

- 0-to-1 & Scale Experience: Demonstrated ability to build operating systems in high-velocity startup environments and scale them to support high-throughput, mission-critical operations where quality control is paramount.

- Strong Data Fluency: comfortable using SQL, spreadsheets, or BI tools to run the business on metrics such as throughput, quality, cost per task, and utilization.

- Contemporary Industry Acumen: Working knowledge of the modern AI landscape (LLMs, multimodal models, training and evaluation pipelines) to partner credibly with researchers and engineers.

- Executive Stakeholder Management: Excellent business acumen, executive presence, and communication style with experience building high-trust partnerships with top-tier AI labs, customers, and enterprise executive teams

- Education: B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, AI, or a related technical field with 12+ years of industry experience (or Ph.D. with 8+ years).

Preferred Skills 

- Experience at an AI data, human data, or language services company, or delivering for frontier AI labs.

- Experience leading globally distributed teams across time zones.

- Familiarity with Python and modern program tooling (e.g., Linear, Jira, custom analytics) to automate reporting and workflows.

- Fluency in multiple human languages.

What We Offer 

- Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package.

- Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology in a rapidly growing industry.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment.

- Significant opportunities for professional growth and development.

- The chance to make a real impact on global communication and business.

Our Story 

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech 

What sets our platform apart:

- Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

- Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

- 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

- Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

LILT in the News 

- Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

- LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List .

- LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

- Check out all our news on our website .

title: Senior Software Engineer - Verification Platform
description:
Beneath a simple yet elegant user interface lies a complex system of functionalities. Our AI-powered product uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions. We help our partners build onboarding processes that ensure good people get things done and bad folks get stopped.

To take our platform to the next level, we're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Verification Platform team. This team owns the workflow orchestration engine and the automated verification decisioning pipeline that powers Veriff 's core product — and that other product teams across Identity, Fraud, and End User Platform build on top of. Your work will directly determine the reliability, scalability, and capabilities of the flows that thousands of people go through every day.

You’ll help us protect honest people online by: 

- Designing, building, and operating VP's backend services, including the orchestration engine and the automated decisioning pipeline, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability

- Delivering key orchestration features such as multi-method flow execution, branching and fallback logic, and webhook integrations

- Improving the resilience of production-critical systems — backpressure and idempotency handling, backwards-compatibility testing, SPOF elimination, and end-to-end monitoring

- Participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and postmortems to ensure our most critical flows stay healthy

- Driving engineering quality through code reviews, CI practices, runbook documentation, and mentoring teammates

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have: 

- 5+ years of experience building large-scale backend applications with Python, including event-driven and async architectures with message queues (e.g. SQS or similar)

- Proven ownership of production-critical services — you understand what it means to be on-call and take reliability seriously

- Deep experience designing for resilience in distributed systems: idempotency, backpressure, retries, backwards compatibility

- Strong understanding of modular design approaches and SOLID principles

- Hands-on experience building scalable, maintainable APIs

- Proficiency in a range of testing strategies that ensure robust and reliable software

- Solid understanding of relational database fundamentals

- Familiarity with structured logging and observability practices

- Strong communication skills — you can clearly articulate technical ideas to engineers and non-engineers alike

You’re an especially awesome match if you have: 

- Experience with workflow or orchestration engines, event-driven systems, Kubernetes, or identity verification domain knowledge.

You can get familiar with our tech stack on StackShare .

Why Veriff? 

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force. 

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...

- Flexibility to work from home

- Stock options that ensure your share in our success

- Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation

- Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally

- Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs

- Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary 

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

title: Network Architect / Network Specialist (On‑Prem, Global)
description:
Position Overview 

Agile Robots SE is seeking a Network Architect / Network Specialist to define and operate our global on‑premise network across multiple geographies and regional offices. You will lead the design and lifecycle of our campus, branch, and data‑center networks—including high‑performance NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics that power AI/HPC workloads—while ensuring our controls meet TISAX expectations and internal ISMS requirements.

Key Responsibilities 

1) Global Architecture & Standards (On‑Prem Only) 

- Design and document end‑to‑end on‑prem architectures (core/distribution/access/WLAN; DC leaf‑spine).

- Establish and maintain global standards: IP addressing & IPAM (NetBox), routing policy, QoS, naming, security baselines, and change control (HLD/LLD, MOP/SOP, rollback).

- Define network zoning & segmentation (VLAN/VRF; optional EVPN/VXLAN where justified) across Officeand DMZ networks with clear trust boundaries.

2) Routing, Switching, WLAN & Regional Sites 

- Engineer BGP/OSPF for WAN & DC; deliver redundancy/failover across carriers and sites.

- Own Aruba campus/branch switching and WLAN (coverage, capacity planning, RF hygiene, roaming, WPA2/3‑Enterprise).

- Plan and execute site builds/moves/expansions (circuits, last‑mile, demarc, handoffs, cutovers) with measurable downtime windows.

3) Security, Remote Access & Identity 

- Lead FortiGate policy architecture (zones, NAT, segmentation, IDS/IPS) and FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL) for site‑to‑site and remote access, including HA and posture checks.

- Implement 802.1X NAC (e.g., Aruba ClearPass) with RADIUS/Active Directory integration; enforce device posture and guest segmentation.

- Operate DMZ patterns (reverse proxying, jump hosts, constrained admin planes) and align with TISAX/ISMSrequirements.

4) High‑Performance Networking for AI/HPC 

- Design, deploy, and maintain NVIDIA InfiniBand fabrics (topology, cabling/optics, partitioning), including subnet managers ( UFM/opensm ), congestion control, and path optimization.

- Coordinate with compute/storage teams (e.g., DGX/HPC clusters) on throughput, latency, and scale; plan upgrades and fabric expansions.

5) Reliability, Observability & Automation 

- Deliver high availability (fast convergence, dual‑homing, link aggregation/MLAG/VLT) and tested DR/failover.

- Implement proactive monitoring/alerting (e.g., Zabbix), telemetry/SNMP, and capacity trends; maintain RCAs and SLOs.

- Centralize logging with rsyslog and FortiAnalyzer; enforce retention and integrity for audits.

- Use NetBox, Ansible/Python, and Git‑based workflows for configuration management, drift control, and repeatable changes.

6) Compliance, Risk & Vendor Management (TISAX Focus) 

- Map network controls to TISAX expectations (ISMS governance, secure remote access, logging, supplier access, data protection).

- Partner with ISMS owner/CISO on risk assessments, controls testing , and evidence preparation for audits (policies, diagrams, logs, change records).

- Manage carriers and vendors (Fortinet, Aruba, Dell; integrators); lead RFPs, SLAs, and lifecycle planning.

- Mentor regional IT; act as L3 escalation for incidents and major changes.

Core Technologies @ Agile Robots SE 

- Security & Remote Access: FortiGate NGFW, FortiGate VPN (IPsec/SSL), FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer.

- Campus/Branch & WLAN: Aruba CX/AOS switching, controllers/APs, ClearPass (802.1X), AirWave (on‑prem mgmt).

- Data Center & Fabric: Dell PowerSwitch (OS10), VLT/MLAG; NVIDIA InfiniBand (UFM/opensm).

- Foundational Services: VLAN/VRF, BGP/OSPF, QoS; DHCP/DNS, Active Directory, RADIUS; NetBox(IPAM/DCIM).

- Observability & Automation: Zabbix, rsyslog (retention policy), NetFlow/sFlow; Ansible/Python, Git.

Qualifications 

Required 

- 7+ years in enterprise on‑prem networking across multi‑site/multi‑region environments.

- Deep hands‑on with FortiGate, Aruba (switching/WLAN), Dell data‑center switching, and NVIDIA InfiniBand basics.

- Strong routing/switching (BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VRF), segmentation, and DMZ design; HA and fast convergence patterns.

- Proven delivery of secure remote access, 802.1X NAC, and logging/monitoring at scale (rsyslog, analyzers, NMS).

- Experience aligning network controls to ISMS/TISAX (policy ↔ design ↔ evidence).

- Excellent documentation (HLD/LLD, diagrams) and stakeholder communication.

Preferred 

- Certifications: Fortinet NSE (4/5/7+), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP/ACSP/ACDX), CCNP/CCIE, Dell networking, and/or NVIDIA networking.

- ClearPass NAC depth, FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer, Aruba AirWave; EVPN/VXLAN familiarity.

- Exposure to RADIUS/AD integration and FreeRADIUS stack.

- Familiarity with Zabbix tuning, syslog retention strategies, and ITSM/change tooling.

- Experience segmenting AI/HPC clusters and integrating with storage/compute pipelines.

What we offer 

- 
A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.

- 
Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.

- 
Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.

- 
Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.

- 
Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.

- 
Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us 

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio, together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Manufacturing Test Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Job Overview: 
We are seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to join Anduril, working in a cutting-edge start-up environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in subsea robotics. The Manufacturing Test Engineer will be charged with developing and implementing high-fidelity, automated test processes on both the component and system level. Working closely with engineering staff and a team of skilled electro-mechanical technicians, this role is key to advancing our testing capabilities to ensure the highest levels quality are achieved as we continue drive scalability into our production operations.

Anduril’s Manufacturing team is producing the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles globally at rate. The Manufacturing Engineering team owns production readiness and process engineering across the Undersea Dominance product range — from core vehicle platform to specialised mission payloads, spanning mechanical and electrical hardware build through to full system integration & test.

About the Job 
You will own the test software, automation and tooling that proves every Dive-XL vehicle works before it leaves the building — the Python frameworks that drive instruments and vehicle hardware, the operator-facing GUIs that make complex test sequences safe and repeatable under production pressure, and the interlocks that protect people and product when the system is commanding real high-voltage DC. - Produce and maintain testing logs/data, develop library of error codes with troubleshooting logic/diagrams for fast issue resolution.

- Generate controlled test instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES or other test execution systems.

- Optimize test design and execution of full system “end of line” factory acceptance test (FAT) of AUVs

- Design and execution of PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary

- Are well versed with complex electromechanical systems and are passionate about understanding what it takes to make them work reliably

- Have experience developing full system test plans and know how to execute them on fast-paced product development timelines

- Have experience with programming/testing a wide range of sensors, actuators, and electrical components

- Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government NV2 Security Clearance (Australian citizen).

PREFERRED QUALIFIACTIONS

- Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)

- Demonstrated ability to learn new skills or adapt to new situations. Un-phased by challenges that go beyond the traditional comfort zone or work experience. Multidisciplinary approach to problem solving

title: Algorithm Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What is Anori Tech doing?

The world talks about batteries, cells and the energy transition. Almost nobody talks about the Battery Management System (BMS) that makes them work.

As battery applications multiply, from robotics and mobility to data centers and grid-scale storage, BMS complexity is exploding. Legacy BMS architectures were never built for this: too rigid to keep up with new requirements, they've turned the BMS into the bottleneck of battery development.

We're building something different: a novel software-defined BMS architecture combined with an AI-driven configuration process. It gets battery manufacturers the right BMS for their exact use case within days, regardless of application or cell chemistry.

We're building the battery management system platform of tomorrow. Delivered in days, not years.

Join us and shape one of the fastest growing markets in the energy sector: The BMS market.

Our Motivation

At Anori Tech, we believe everything is energy, and progress runs on it. With Anori we actively shape the energy transition: from oil to electric, from low to high efficiency. We need batteries for this transition and almost all batteries need a BMS. We strive for Shenzhen speed and German engineering quality. Our objective: put Europe back on the map in the race for the energy transition and build technical leadership out of Hamburg.

About the Role

A BMS is only as good as what it knows about the battery. As our Algorithm Engineer, you'll develop the algorithms that tell the Anori BMS what is happening inside the cells: state of charge, state of health and balancing. And you won't stop at the concept: you'll design algorithms, implement them in our embedded Rust firmware and validate them on real hardware. Later on, the role grows into the cloud, where data pipelines and fleet analytics will build on the models you create today. You'll work closely with Stefan, our CTO, and our firmware and hardware engineers.

Start date : from January 1, 2027

What You'll Do

- Develop the algorithms that estimate SoC and SoH for different cell chemistries and applications

- Design balancing strategies that fit the hardware and use case

- Build battery models (e.g. equivalent circuit models) and parameterize them from measurement data with statistical rigor

- Implement your algorithms directly in the embedded Rust firmware, efficient enough for constrained hardware

- Design experiments and evaluation methodologies: analyze failure modes, quantify trade-offs between accuracy, robustness and compute cost

- Support in building data pipelines and fleet analytics in the cloud

What You Bring

Must have

- Hands-on experience with state of charge and state of health estimation, shown in a product, publication or substantial project. For example Kalman-type filters, H∞ filters, observers, or coulomb counting with model-based correction

- Deep understanding of battery behavior and modeling, e.g. equivalent circuit models, hysterisis, ageing or also physics based models

- Experience implementing numerical algorithms on embedded, constrained hardware (e.g. in Rust or C/C++ - heads-up our firmware is written in Rust, and we'll help you get up to speed)

- Strong Python skills for modeling, simulation and data analysis

- Critical, analytical, systematic thinking: you reason from first principles, make your assumptions explicit and challenge existing paradigms

Strongly preferred

- Experience with cell balancing algorithms and their effects

- Working with real cell data from test benches or cyclers

- Signal processing fundamentals: FIR/IIR filter design, sampling and aliasing, noise characterization of sensor data

Nice to have

- Data pipelines, fleet analytics or cloud experience

- Machine learning methods for battery data, for example data-driven state of health estimation or anomaly detection

- Model-based systems engineering and requirements engineering (the skills, not the paper)

You don't tick every box? Apply anyway. No one matches a job description 100%. If this role excites you and you are motivated to grow yourself into it, we want to hear from you.

What We Offer

- Work on a product with purpose that redefines the state of art: our product is a key part to enable competitive battery energy storage.

- Work directly with the founding team on decisions that shape the company. The team is small, so your ideas will matter. A lot.

- Challenging engineering in an industrial, but research-near environment. We bring research into the industry.

- A modern stack and methods: Rust, MBSE, everything as code, and the best tools and techniques for the job, chosen on merit.

- To be both supported and challenged: room to grow, and the expectation that you will.

You might be a fit if

- You hold yourself to a high standard and don’t settle for "good enough."

- You want to have a big say in what the Anori BMS looks like and how it works

- You are eager to try out new tools and enjoy incorporating AI into your work to make your life easier and more productive

- You are excited about startups and all the opportunities and uncertainties that come with it

- You want to be an active part in accelerating the energy transition in Europe

- You are comfortable with English as a working language

- You are happy to be in the office most of the time because for fast decisions we need to be in the same room. We expect you to be in the office at least 3 days / week

Interview Process

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctorant en vision et apprentissage : Détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments
description:
Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire 

Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Avec le Groupe des Écoles Centrale, elle dispose de 3 implantations à l’international. La formation dispensée bénéficie de l’excellence de la recherche des 6 laboratoires labellisés CNRS présents sur ses campus, des 2 laboratoires à l’international, des 6 réseaux de recherche internationaux et des 10 laboratoires communs avec des entreprises. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions.

Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos.

Présentation de la thématique : 

Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments.

Description de la mission 

La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence Artificielle est envisageable.

Le projet THERM_I_BAT vise à concevoir et valider une preuve de concept de diagnostic intelligent des façades de bâtiments, à partir de prises de vues intérieures réalisées par une plateforme robotisée.

Scientifiquement, le projet s’inscrit dans les travaux de recherche et R&D sur l’analyse d’images multimodales et l’apprentissage frugal, en développant de nouveaux modèles d’IA capables de fonctionner avec des jeux de données limités mais fortement contextualisés. Industriellement, il prépare une solution de diagnostic automatisé de la qualité d’enveloppe, compatible avec les outils de la filière (BIM, jumeau numérique) et économiquement acceptable pour un déploiement massif à la réception des bâtiments.

Le planning envisagé est le suivant :

Phase 1 – Acquisition et préparation des données (M1–M12) 

• Définition des protocoles de mesure avec CMDL (typologies de bâtiments, scénarios de défauts).

• Réalisation de campagnes de mesures robotisées (IR + RGB) sur plusieurs sites pilotes.

• Constitution d’un jeu de données annoté (défauts, zones saines, contexte BIM).

Phase 2 – Contextualisation spatiale et fusion multimodale (M3–M5) 

• Alignement spatial des images IR et RGB, prise en compte de la géométrie des façades.

• Développement de méthodes de fusion multimodale pour produire des représentations conjointes robustes.

Phase 3 – Segmentation sémantique et filtrage des perturbations (M6–M9) 

• Développement de modèles de segmentation sémantique pour distinguer les zones pertinentes (parois, menuiseries, éléments techniques) des perturbations (mobilier, objets, reflets).

• Intégration de connaissances expertes CMDL pour guider les classes et les règles de filtrage.

Phase 4 – Détection d’anomalies et classification des défauts (M10–M16) 

• Mise en place de modèles de détection d’anomalies thermiques et de classification des défauts (ponts thermiques, défauts d’étanchéité à l’air, artefacts liés aux matériaux).

• Apprentissage frugal à partir de jeux de données limités, complétés éventuellement par des données simulées.

Phase 5 – Génération du diagnostic et validation en environnement pertinent (M16–M18) 

• Génération automatique de diagnostics structurés (liste de défauts, typologie, sévérité) et localisation dans le plan/BIM.

• Campagnes de validation sur de nouveaux bâtiments, comparaison avec l’analyse d’experts humains (temps, précision, taux de faux positifs/faux négatifs).

• Consolidation de la preuve de concept (TRL 5) et préparation des suites de valorisation.

Profil recherché / Compétences attendues 

Diplômes : Doctorat en Informatique 

Connaissances requises : Vision par Ordinateurs, Apprentissage automatique, Apprentissage profond 

Compétences opérationnelles : Bonne maîtrise du langage Python et de librairies d’apprentissage profond telles que PyTorch, de l’anglais, et bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et de communication orale 

Compétences comportementales : Motivation, rigueur, autonomie, proactivité. 

Le processus de recrutement se déroule en deux étapes, supervisé par une commission de recrutement, en conformité avec la politique OTMR de Centrale Lyon . 

· Étude du dossier écrit : CV + lettre de motivation + diplôme de doctorat

· Entretien de sélection : en présentiel ou en visioconférence

Date limite de candidature : 8 novembre 2026

As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives.

You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production.

What you will do

- Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use.

- Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on.

- Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements.

- Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results.

- Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release.

- Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail.

- Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform.

Who you are

Must have

- Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams.

- Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation.

- Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools.

Nice to have

What you get

title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary 

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We’re looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You’ll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You’ll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do 

- Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

- Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

- Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

- Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You’ll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications 

- Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master’s degree program.

- Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.

- Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.

- An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.

- Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive .

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You’ll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values 

- Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

- Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

- Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

- Own it and get it done. Results matter!

- Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

- Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Impact 

- Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance

- Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows

- Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

- Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

- Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data

- Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

Your Profile 

- PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or

- Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience

- Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time

- Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation

- Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

- Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

- Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

- Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

- Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

- Excellent communication skills in English

Bonus Points 

- Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

- Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

- Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

- Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

- Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

- A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

With Pagelove, AI can finally build web applications without having to deal with the complexity of the full stack. We’re seed-stage and well-funded, hiring our first non-founder engineer. title: Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer
description:
Data, software & technische toepassingen 

FULLTIME · ROTTERDAM 

Wil jij data en software inzetten voor een fysieke technologie die bijdraagt aan een energiezuinigere en duurzamere glastuinbouw? 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor hightech kassen. Onze projecten leveren uiteenlopende klimaat-, energie-, sensor- en productdata op. Deze data vormt de basis voor betrouwbare analyses, klantinzichten en verdere verbetering van onze technologie. 

We zoeken een Senior Data Analyst / Software Engineer die sterke analytische vaardigheden combineert met praktische softwareontwikkeling. Je helpt een schaalbare data- en softwareomgeving op te bouwen: van data-inname en kwaliteitscontrole tot dashboards, analyseprocessen en technische tools. 

Je werkt niet op afstand van het fysieke product. Je werkt direct samen met engineers, onderzoekers en analisten aan toepassingen voor kas- en klantprojecten.

Taken

Wat ga je doen? 

Data-infrastructuur en datakwaliteit 

Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt betrouwbare datastromen voor sensoren, technische systemen en andere relevante databronnen. 

Je structureert de opslag, verwerking en beschikbaarheid van project- en tijdreeksdata. 

Je ontwikkelt methoden om data uit verschillende systemen en formaten goed samen te brengen. 

Je automatiseert controles, monitoring en foutafhandeling. 

Je stelt praktische standaarden op voor datakwaliteit, documentatie, traceerbaarheid en versiebeheer. 

Je zorgt dat data bruikbaar en beschikbaar is voor analyses, dashboards, technische evaluaties en productontwikkeling. 

Je houdt rekening met passende toegang en bescherming van klantdata en interne kennis. 

Data-analyse en technische inzichten 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare analyseprocessen voor klimaat-, energie- en productdata. 

Je analyseert tijdreeksen en helpt verschillen tussen situaties, perioden en projecten te verklaren. 

Je ondersteunt de ontwikkeling van betrouwbare vergelijkingen, baselines en prestatieberekeningen. 

Je vertaalt statistische en technische resultaten naar duidelijke inzichten voor engineers en andere collega’s. 

Je beoordeelt en verbetert analyses van de Data Analyst. 

Je werkt samen met Performance en R&D om technische methoden om te zetten in betrouwbare analyses. 

Je bepaalt welke analyses geautomatiseerd kunnen worden en waar inhoudelijke interpretatie nodig blijft. 

Software en technische tools 

Je bouwt software waarmee technische teams projecten sneller en consistenter kunnen analyseren. 

Je ontwikkelt praktische tools voor berekeningen, scenarioanalyses, projectevaluaties en technische besluitvorming. 

Je zet prototypes en onderzoeksresultaten om in betrouwbare, onderhoudbare software. 

Je integreert relevante interne en externe rekenmethoden in bruikbare toepassingen. 

Je ontwikkelt waar relevant koppelingen met externe systemen en platforms. 

Je werkt mee aan zowel de technische achterkant als gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces. 

Je zorgt dat technische kennis op een veilige en beheersbare manier in software wordt toegepast. 

Dashboards en rapportages 

Je ontwikkelt interne en klantgerichte dashboards voor het monitoren en evalueren van projecten. 

Je bouwt duidelijke visualisaties van klimaatomstandigheden, energiegebruik en productprestaties. 

Je automatiseert terugkerende rapportages met behoud van traceerbare berekeningen en aannames. 

Je zorgt dat dashboards en rapportages begrijpelijk zijn voor engineers, telers en commerciële collega’s. 

Je ontwikkelt herbruikbare rapportages voor verschillende typen projecten en klanten. 

Je bewaakt dat klantgerichte resultaten aansluiten op de onderliggende gevalideerde methoden. 

Technisch eigenaarschap en begeleiding 

Je maakt technische keuzes die passen bij een groeiende organisatie en toekomstige opschaling. 

Je introduceert praktische standaarden voor softwareontwikkeling, documentatie, testen en versiebeheer. 

Je begeleidt de Data Analyst of werkstudent en beoordeelt complexere analyses en ontwikkelwerkzaamheden. 

Je helpt software- en datawerk te prioriteren op basis van behoeften vanuit klantprojecten, engineering en productontwikkeling. 

Je bepaalt wanneer een snelle analyse voldoende is en wanneer een schaalbare softwareoplossing nodig is. 

Je werkt waar nodig samen met externe specialisten. 

Je helpt de bredere Data & Software-functie binnen Thermeleon op te bouwen. 

Hoe werk je samen met de andere functies? 

Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead Application & Systems Engineer en de Data Analyst. 

De Lead Application & Systems Engineer bepaalt welke klant- en engineeringvragen moeten worden beantwoord. 

Jij vertaalt die vragen naar passende data-, analyse- en softwareoplossingen. 

De Data Analyst ondersteunt bij datavoorbereiding, analyses, dashboarding, monitoring en rapportages. 

Performance en R&D ontwikkelen en valideren technische methoden en onderliggende kennis. 

Jij vertaalt deze methoden naar betrouwbare analyseprocessen en bruikbare software. 

Productontwikkeling en Hardware leveren technische vereisten en productinformatie. 

Samen zorgen jullie dat projectdata wordt omgezet in inzichten, klantwaarde en productverbeteringen. 

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid van de data- en software-implementatie. Performance en R&D blijven verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke validatie van technische methoden. De Lead Application & Systems Engineer blijft verantwoordelijk voor de toepassing in het geïntegreerde klantadvies.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken we? 

Je hebt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in computer science, data science, engineering, toegepaste wiskunde, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. 

Je hebt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering of technische data-analyse. 

Je hebt sterke Python-vaardigheden en ervaring met het bouwen van onderhoudbare software- of analysetoepassingen. 

Je hebt ervaring met tijdreeksdata, API’s, databases en dataverwerking. 

Je hebt ervaring met back-endontwikkeling en met het opleveren van praktische interfaces of dashboards. 

Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt je verdiepen in fysieke en operationele systemen. 

Je kunt verkennende analyses en prototypes omzetten in robuuste, herbruikbare oplossingen. 

Je kunt pragmatische technische keuzes maken binnen een groeiende organisatie. 

Je beheerst het Engels professioneel. Nederlands is waardevol, maar geen vereiste. 

Je kunt technische keuzes duidelijk uitleggen aan collega’s zonder softwareachtergrond. 

Extra waardevol 

Ervaring met data uit energie, industrie, gebouwtechnologie, glastuinbouw of IoT. 

Kennis van statistiek, experimenteel ontwerp en onzekerheidsanalyse. 

Ervaring met cloudinfrastructuur, geautomatiseerd testen en deployment. 

Ervaring met Python, SQL en relevante data- en visualisatietools. 

Ervaring met tijdreeks- en sensordata. 

Ervaring met het omzetten van technische of wetenschappelijke rekenmethoden naar softwaretoepassingen. 

Ervaring met het begeleiden van junior analisten of ontwikkelaars. 

Interesse in thermodynamica, energiesystemen of glastuinbouw. 

Je past waarschijnlijk goed bij ons als je 

Graag werkt op het snijvlak van data-analyse en softwareontwikkeling. 

Wilt dat je werk invloed heeft op een fysiek product en echte klantprojecten. 

Structuur kunt aanbrengen in data en systemen die nog in ontwikkeling zijn. 

Zowel analytische correctheid als bruikbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid belangrijk vindt. 

Minder ervaren collega’s graag helpt zich te ontwikkelen. 

Praktische tools wilt bouwen die daadwerkelijk binnen projecten worden gebruikt.

Benefits

Wat bieden we? 

Een sleutelrol in de ontwikkeling van onze data- en softwareomgeving. 

Een brede functie waarin data engineering, analyse, software en productontwikkeling samenkomen. 

Directe betrokkenheid bij fysieke systemen en praktijkprojecten. 

De mogelijkheid om technische keuzes, standaarden en werkwijzen mede te bepalen. 

Samenwerking met engineers, onderzoekers, telers en technologiepartners. 

De mogelijkheid om collega’s te begeleiden en de Data & Software-functie verder op te bouwen. 

Een passend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket op basis van je ervaring. 

Een hybride werkomgeving rond ons kantoor in Rotterdam.

Over Thermeleon 

Thermeleon ontwikkelt een innovatieve Warmtebatterij voor de glastuinbouw. Met onze technologie helpen we telers hun fossiele warmtevraag, energiekosten en CO₂-uitstoot te verlagen. 

We werken samen met telers, kennisinstellingen en technologiepartners om onze technologie verder te ontwikkelen, te valideren en toe te passen. Binnen Thermeleon werk je direct aan de verbinding tussen fysieke technologie, software, data en de praktijk in de kas.

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

- Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
- Youâre hungry to learn more
- Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate
The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Monthly team events and activities
- Weekly team lunches
- Casual dress code
- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

If this sounds like a position for you, please respond to this advertisement with your resume and cover letter. Please, read carefully:

1. Write a cover letter addressing:

- Why are you the best Associate Data Scientist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements.
- Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view
- What's the toughest challenge youâve ever overcome in your life? How did you overcome it?
- What are the last three books youâve read?
- What do you do for fun?
2. Explain what youâre doing now for a job:

- If you donât have one, explain why.
- If you have one, explain why youâre looking elsewhere.
3. Upload your cover letter and resume

- Ensure that your cover letter and resume are saved and sent as one file.
Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

Click the âApply Nowâ button on this page and upload your cover letter and resume.

***Note: Please include your cover letter WITH your resume in one document. Applications without a cover letter will not be read!***

We are looking to hire as soon as we find the right person, so act quickly and you can also expect a prompt response.

Please mention the word **EARNESTNESS** and tag RMTcyLjIxMi4xNTEuMjMz when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTcyLjIxMi4xNTEuMjMz). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker.

This role is based in Singapore

title: Head of Investment Fund Operations
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Head of Fund Operations to oversee the operational management of a diverse Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio within an established international private banking environment.

In this responsible leadership role, you will manage a small team of fund operations specialists and ensure reliable, accurate and efficient processes across fund data, cost management, NAV controls and reporting. You will work closely with internal stakeholders as well as fund administrators, system providers, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. As a member of the Valuation Committee, you will also contribute your expertise to fund valuation-related decisions.

The position offers a combination of team leadership, fund operations expertise, data management, regulatory knowledge and process automation , with considerable scope to improve existing processes and further professionalise the operational setup.

Location: Basel

Your Responsibilities: 

- Manage and develop a team of three Fund Operations specialists and oversee operations for the complete Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- Ensure the availability, integrity and quality of fund data across the relevant internal systems

- Monitor end-to-end data flows and act as the key contact for the external system provider

- Review and validate important fund indicators such as TER, PTR, OGC and transaction costs

- Take ownership of the PRIIPs KID production process and ensure that the underlying information is accurate and up to date

- Manage the relationship with CACEIS concerning NAV data, including plausibility controls and the investigation and resolution of discrepancies

- Participate in valuation-related decisions as an active member of the Valuation Committee

- Coordinate the preparation and publication of annual and semi-annual fund reports

- Liaise with auditors and tax advisors and oversee relevant fund-related tax topics

- Review fund-related invoices and ensure transparency and accuracy of associated costs

- Coordinate the preparation of factsheets, monthly fund manager reports and regular reporting for wholesale clients

- Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, automation and data quality

- Drive the use of automation and data-driven approaches to improve fund operations and reporting

- Ensure that operational processes and reporting activities are aligned with applicable Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory requirements

- Serve as a knowledgeable and reliable contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers across fund operations

Your Profile: 

- At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in fund operations, fund controlling, fund accounting, fund administration or fund audit

- Comprehensive knowledge of the Swiss and Luxembourg fund landscape, ideally including CISA, FINMA, AMAS, UCITS and CSSF regulations

- Practical experience with NAV control and oversight and cooperation with external fund administrators

- Previous experience with CACEIS is considered an advantage

- Strong knowledge of fund reporting, data management, valuation processes and fund-related cost structures

- Good technical capabilities, including Python or a comparable scripting language, advanced Excel and experience working with databases and SQL

- Experience in automating operational, data or reporting processes is highly desirable

- Strong analytical skills and a precise, structured approach to complex data and processes

- A proactive, hands-on working style with a high degree of personal responsibility

- Previous leadership or people management experience is an advantage

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions and organisations

- High level of integrity, reliability and accountability

- Comfortable working in an international, regulated financial services environment

- University or FH degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting or a comparable discipline

- Excellent English skills; German and French are advantageous

What We Offer: 

- A senior position with broad responsibility for the operational management of a Swiss and Luxembourg fund portfolio

- The opportunity to shape and further improve the Fund Operations function and its processes

- A varied role combining leadership, fund operations, data and automation

- Regular interaction with senior internal stakeholders and key external partners

- The opportunity to contribute to the Valuation Committee and support important fund-related decisions

- Significant scope to introduce process improvements and strengthen automation and data quality

- An international environment within an established and reputable private banking organisation

- Flexible working arrangements and a modern working environment

- Opportunities for continued professional and personal development

Wagmo is a modern pet healthcare company built around how pet parents actually care for their pets. - Youâve designed or substantially refactored a system the business depends on, such as payments or claims, without breaking it, and left it easier to change than you found it.

description:
Ditto | Engineering & Product | Remote (US: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) + APAC | Full-time
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. Remote in the U.S. (hubs: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) unless noted. - Remote-first; North America (CT +/- 2) or Europe (CET +/- 1). Strong async work habits; 4 hrs/week of scheduled meetings on average; pairing/huddles when useful.
- We use AI aggressively and prudently. You'll have a large token budget, but we expect strong judgment around the risks. We discuss compensation early so neither side wastes time. - Apply: https://www.trinsic.id/careers/senior-product-engineer?utm_s... ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

-

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

What you’ll do 

- 
Build safety systems: Design, develop, and scale automated moderation systems, abuse detection capabilities, and guardrails for AI agents across ElevenLabs’ products.

- 
Respond to emerging threats: Partner closely with the Investigations team to identify emerging abuse patterns, understand evolving threats, and continuously improve existing safety systems, detection mechanisms, and guardrails to address new risks.

- 
Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

- 
Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale.

- 
Build end-to-end solutions: Develop backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing interfaces that enable effective moderation, safety operations, and policy enforcement.

- 
Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Safety Policy teams to translate business, regulatory, and policy requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

- 
Product: Understand and navigate the tradeoffs between product growth, user experience, and platform safety.

- 
Legal: Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable safety systems.

- 
Safety Policy: Collaborate on how safety policies are implemented technically, while helping inform policy decisions through an understanding of engineering capabilities and constraints.

- 
Shape our technical direction: Contribute to architectural decisions and help define how our safety infrastructure evolves as our products, users, and safety challenges grow.

Requirements 

- 
5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

- 
Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services.

- 
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

- 
Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

- 
Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

- 
Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed.

- 
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions.

Bonus 

- 
Experience building Trust & Safety, content moderation, fraud detection, or abuse prevention systems.

- 
Experience building guardrails or safety infrastructure for AI agents and LLM-based applications.

- 
Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications.

- 
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

- 
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

- 
Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.

- 
Experience with real-time data processing, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka and Redis.

Location 

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
